symbols.name: EEex_GameState_AddDestroyedListener
symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Registers a listener function that is called immediately after the engine has cleaned up a game session. Examples of when this occurs include the user quitting to the main menu, loading a save, etc.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| listener | function |  | The listener to register. |

symbols.name: EEex_GameState_AddInitializedListener
symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Registers a listener function that is called immediately after the engine's Lua environment has been initialized. This only occurs once during the engine's early start up process. If the engine has already been initialized, `listener` is called immediately.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| listener | function |  | The listener to register. |

symbols.name: EEex_GameState_GetGlobalInt

parameters.name: variableName
parameters.description: The name of the variable to fetch.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Returns the integer value of the `variableName` Global scoped to `GLOBAL`. If no variable named `variableName` exists, returns `0`.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variableName | string |  | The name of the variable to fetch. |

**Return Values:**

| **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| number | See summary. |

symbols.name: EEex_GameState_GetGlobalString

parameters.name: variableName
parameters.description: The name of the variable to fetch.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Returns the string value of the `variableName` Global scoped to `GLOBAL`. If no variable named `variableName` exists, returns `""`.

> **Note**
> Global string values can only be accessed through EEex functions.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variableName | string |  | The name of the variable to fetch. |

**Return Values:**

| **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| string | See summary. |

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set the variable to.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Sets the integer value of the `variableName` Global scoped to `GLOBAL` to `value`.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variableName | string |  | The name of the variable to set. |
| value | number |  | The value to set the variable to. |

symbols.name: EEex_GameState_SetGlobalString

parameters.name: variableName
parameters.description: The name of the variable to set.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set the variable to.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Sets the string value of the `variableName` Global scoped to `GLOBAL` to `value`.

> **Note**
> Global string values can only be accessed through EEex functions.

> **Warning**
> Global string values can be a maximum of 32 characters. Attempting to set a value that is longer than 32 characters will result in the value being truncated.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variableName | string |  | The name of the variable to set. |
| value | string |  | The value to set the variable to. |

symbols.name: EEex_GameState_TogglePause

parameters.name: bLogPause
parameters.description: Determines whether a message is written to the combat log.

parameters.name: bVisualPause
parameters.description: Determines whether the engine renders screen-edge arrows and forces party markers during pause.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Toggles the pause status of the game.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bLogPause | boolean | `true` | Determines whether a message is written to the combat log. |
| bVisualPause | boolean | `true` | Determines whether the engine renders screen-edge arrows and forces party markers during pause. |
| bRequireHostUnpause | boolean | `false` | Unknown. |
| nIdPlayerPause | number | `0` | Unknown. |
| bSendMessage | boolean | `true` | Unknown. |

symbols.name: EEex_GameState_WouldWorldScreenProcessInput
symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Returns `true` if the world screen would currently process a keypress.

> **Note**
> It is the caller's responsibility to check if the active engine is the world screen and if a text edit is currently focused.

**Return Values:**

| **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| boolean | See summary. |
